## Public-boundary checklist

- [ ] I have the right to submit this work under the repository's published
      contribution terms.
- [ ] No ISO, XEX, asset, key, title update, DLC, save, proprietary SDK material,
      leaked source/symbol, generated translation, or linked game binary is
      included.
- [ ] Any third-party code has an exact source, revision, compatible license, and
      required attribution.
- [ ] Logs, traces, paths, tokens, device identifiers, and personal data are
      sanitized.
- [ ] `./tools/check-repository-boundary.ps1` passes.
